params.name: Top bar button
params.tooltip:
How the Problem Radar button in the top-left bar looks.
Text: the word "Radar", the dot and the count, no frame.
Tile: only the coloured dot and the count, on a dark tile
like the game's data layers button.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Problem Radar writes how
long its scans and windows took to the game's log file
(stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]). Only for
tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls
are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
